items.html: And so, in seven years the Keter of ZA was completely corrected, for the Keter is the aspect of the seven of the skull. And this was in seven years; and now he is twenty years old. And afterwards the secret of the brain of ZA, called Hochma, was also corrected, as is known — for you already know that the correction of the brain is revealed in the beard; and then, after the twenty years, the beard of ZA is corrected, and then the secret of the beard sparkles within him. Therefore the beard is not formed in a man until twenty years.
